content.short: Rug Rumble is a Monad game where players run through doors to multiply MON before cashing out.
content.description: Rug Rumble is a game on Monad where players compete over the tokens they hold, framed as a race to a 100x return. Matches resolve on-chain and outcomes are settled in the tokens staked into them.
content.meta: A cash-out game on Monad where the multiplier grows until the player goes one door too far.
